payload.entry: VERIFIED RESULT (2026-10-24): Root cause on SHA 833e58259f69bb365e13ada87ebd80de83ea23c4 was an expectation mismatch in the new regression test: fake-bob omits the pull_in capability, so decoding correctly yields nil; the test expected Optional(false), causing three assertions to fail for x*, x!, and x*2. The correction changes only those expected values to nil and keeps all strict argv assertions. Expected writes: x*, x!, x*2 each use capture --format json --refuse-override -- <draft>; x*!2 uses capture --format json --require-pull-in-choice --refuse-override -- x*!2; confirmed override = uses capture --format json --require-pull-in-choice -- =; the unpreviewed override first uses --refuse-override and the second Return uses --require-pull-in-choice. `just portable-check` passed (exit 0).
